newsitem.title: UK: Ronson chair, finance director to step down.
newsitem.headline: Ronson chair, finance director to step down.

text.p: Consumer brands distributor Ronson Plc said on Tuesday its chairman, James Roe, planned to stand down from the post after the annual general meeting in 1997.
Roe will remain a non-executive director of the company.
The company also said David Moffatt resigned as finance director with immediate effect.
Ronson said Shaun Dowling, a non-executive director of the firm, was named deputy chairman, effective immediately.

Dowling will become chairman after the AGM, the company said in a statement. Ronson added that Christine Pickles will assume the responsibilities of Moffatt for the time being, in addition to her role as corporate development director.
Frances McCarthy, a solicitor, will replace her as company secretary, the firm said.
